download.title: Android ke liye PashuPoshan Download Karein
download.subtitle: Official signed APK release (v1.0) - offline support, native camera capture aur on-device storage ke saath.
download.step1Desc: Upar diye gaye download button par tap karke apne phone me PashuPoshan.apk download karein.
download.step2Title: 2. File Open Karein aur Permission dein
download.step2Desc: Download hone ke baad notification ya phone ke Downloads folder se APK kholein. Agar phone unknown apps install warn kare, to Settings me jaakar 'Allow from this source' enable karein.
download.step3Desc: Agar Google Play Protect warning dikhaye kyunki app direct browser se download hua hai, to 'More details' dabakar 'Install anyway' select karein.
download.step4Title: 4. Open karein aur test shuru karein
download.step4Desc: PashuPoshan open karein, camera permission allow karein aur feed & silage test karna start karein!
download.feature1: Field me clear photos ke liye fast camera autofocus aur flash controls
download.feature2: Bina internet pure on-device test aur secure local cache
download.feature3: Smooth back button navigation aur dark mode
download.feature4: Install ke baad rural farms me zero internet data usage
download.qrTitle: Phone Camera se Scan Karke Download Karein
download.qrSubtitle: Apne phone ke camera ya scanner se direct APK download karne ke liye scan karein.
